name: IPS Order Label for WooCommerce
author: ipsorder

sections.description:
IPS Order Label gives shop managers a complete product-label solution for
WooCommerce shop archives and single product pages.

  • Create unlimited labels with priorities and schedules.
  • Match products, categories, attributes, stock, new and sale status.
  • Combine OR groups containing AND conditions.
  • Style text, colors, shape, size, opacity, spacing and placement.
  • Preview changes before saving.
  • Use WooCommerce hooks, stable data attributes and an optional lightweight
    repositioning helper for dynamic layouts.

The WordPress.org package has no license requirement, private updater, Pro
route, tracking, telemetry or locked Pro interface.

Extend label automation with Pro

The free plugin includes the complete everyday product-label workflow. The
optional, separately distributed Pro edition adds tools for stores with more
advanced campaign and automation needs:

  • Additional automation rules for sales metrics, audiences and compatible
    promotion providers.
  • Dynamic and multilingual label text, recurring schedules and countdowns.
  • Variation-aware labels on variable single-product pages.
  • Reusable Brand Styles, campaign templates and additional CSS shapes.
  • Label import/export, campaign planning and affected-product diagnostics.

Pro is not required to create, schedule, style or display product labels.

Learn more: https://ipsorder.com/plugins/plugin-label/

Documentation and support

Documentation: https://docs.ipsorder.com/ips-order-label/
Support: https://ipsorder.com/support/

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.4 or newer.
  • WooCommerce 8.5 or newer.
  • PHP 7.4 or newer.

For production shops, the recommended environment is the latest stable
WordPress and WooCommerce releases with PHP 8.3 or 8.4.

Privacy

Label rules are evaluated locally. This package does not collect customer data
and does not send store, product or customer data to IPS services. Updates are
handled by WordPress.org.

Source and Build Tools

Human-readable React and TypeScript source, exact lock files and the Vite build
configuration are included. With Node.js 22 and npm installed, rebuild the
shipped administration and storefront assets from the plugin directory:

npm ci --prefix ips-admin-react
npm ci --prefix ips-react
npm run build:wordpress-org-assets

The generated files are written to ips-admin-react/build and
ips-react/build. Third-party copyright and license details are documented in
THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt, licenses/MIT.txt and vendor/composer/LICENSE.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install and activate IPS Order Label for WooCommerce.
  3. Open IPS > Label and create the first rule.
sections.faq:
Does this package require an account or license?

No.

Does it replace WooCommerce templates?

No. It uses normal WooCommerce hooks and adds scoped markup and styles.
